quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek press release: LG Innotek is Collaborating with NVIDIA, Taking One Step (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LG Innotek says it is collaborating with NVIDIA to build sensing solutions for physical AI and robotics: at GTC Berlin (10-20-2026) it showed a 3-megapixel camera module and a Multi-modal Vision System designed to implement NVIDIA Holoscan Sensor Bridge (HSB) technology (a showcase, not a supply contract). The two companies plan to expand the collaboration to vision sensing and robotic hands for humanoid robots integrated with NVIDIA's next-generation platform using HSB, with solutions to be unveiled at next year's CES and GTC. LG Innotek also says it is developing robotic components with Boston Dynamics and has begun mass production of camera modules for North American robotics clients.
quarterly_data.figure: 3-megapixel camera module; next-generation solutions to be unveiled at next year's CES and GTC
